smart_join_provider_id.hint: Fallback used when a profile has not chosen Smart context (LLM). Empty uses the bot's current chat model.

smart_join_history_count.hint: Fallback history window used when a profile has not configured its own value.

smart_join_activeness.hint: Fallback prompt activeness used when a profile has not configured its own value.

smart_join_gate_enable.hint: Fallback setting used when a profile has not configured its own value.

smart_join_gate_probability.hint: Probability that a message reaches the model decision step.

smart_join_gate_mode.hint: Raw uses independent random draws. Uniform spacing spreads allowed messages evenly.

profile_snapshots.hint: Internal data used to preserve profile fields across AstrBot restarts.
